record_body:
HubSpot Company Summary — OrbitDesk (orbitdesk.ai)

Firmographics
- Product: AI helpdesk / customer support automation platform (agent-assist + auto-draft responses)
- HQ: North America (US) — prefers US-only processing today; asked about regional isolation as they expand
- Size: 51–200 employees
- Current state: Self-serve Hosted API user (production traffic)

Why this is in Sales now (PLG signal context)
- High-intent trigger: repeated 429s (rate-limit / quota) + latency complaints over multiple days.
- Secondary indicators: spend uptrend and sustained token volume (unknown exact $ in this record; see internal dashboards). SDR outreach was triggered via PLG signal routing.

Current stage
- Evaluation (moving toward a Dedicated trial / POC if sizing + networking checks out).

Workload / technical notes
- Primary workload: chat-style generation for support agent drafts + summarization of long tickets.
- Traffic pattern: bursty (ticket storms). They described “10–20x spikes for ~15–30 minutes” during incidents and product launches.
- Pain points reported:
  - 429s: app currently retries quickly, which worsens spikes. They want a more predictable envelope.
  - Latency: tail latency during peak concurrency. Quote paraphrase: “It’s fine off-peak, but during a surge the UI feels stuck.”
- Requirements (initial):
  - Predictable throughput under burst with bounded tail latency.
  - Prefer dedicated capacity vs. continuing to raise limits on shared hosted tier.
  - Interested in Redwood Optimize guidance (batching/caching) if it reduces p95/p99 and cost.

Security / compliance
- Asked about:
  - SOC 2 status and security artifacts
  - SSO/SAML for console access
  - Audit logging
  - Data retention controls
  - US-only processing (data residency)
- No formal security review started yet, but they flagged procurement will ask.

Ownership / coverage
- AE: Stephanie Nguyen
- SE: Markus Klein (requested to run deep dive on concurrency + latency tuning + Dedicated sizing)
- CS: Jasmine Liu looped because this is already production usage and includes support escalations.

Timeline (recent)
- 2025-02-18 — Company created via PLG signal routing (signal: repeated 429s + latency complaints).
- 2025-02-19 — SDR outreach initiated (sequence: rate-limit pain variant). Notes: keep copy concrete; avoid assumptions about their infra stack.
- 2025-02-21 — Support ticket opened: SUP-2078 ("Frequent 429s on /chat/completions during peaks; p99 latency spikes"). Support asked for request IDs + timestamps and advised retry/backoff changes.
- 2025-02-24 — Internal handoff: SDR → AE. AE requested SE deep dive; flagged potential Dedicated path if they can share peak concurrency distribution and target SLO.
- 2025-03-03 — Meeting booked from signal outreach (ref: thread_2025_03_03_meeting-booked-from-signal). Pre-read requested: current quotas, token/sec target, regions, and any data residency constraints.
- 2025-03-06 — AE/SE sync: decision to prepare two sizing options (baseline + burst) and propose POC success criteria (p95/p99 latency, max sustained RPS, error rate). CS asked to ensure suppression rules prevent duplicate SDR pings while evaluation is active.

Open questions
- What is their real peak concurrency at the Redwood gateway (not just app-level metrics)? Need 7/14/30d windows + peak 5-min bins.
- Which models are they pinned to today? Any flexibility on model variant/fallback during peaks?
- Do they need VPC Private now, or can they start Dedicated in Redwood-managed env and migrate later?

Next steps / plan
- SE deep dive (Markus) to review:
  - client retry strategy + recommended exponential backoff / jitter
  - batching/caching opportunities and how it impacts tail latency
  - Dedicated sizing (GPU pool recommendation) and expected throughput/latency envelopes
  - region + residency options (US)
- AE to send a short POC proposal with success criteria + timeline (2 weeks) after deep dive.

Internal notes (CRM shorthand)
- “This is not a maybe — they’re already hurting in prod.”
- If Dedicated: position as predictable throughput + isolation; keep private/VPC as phase 2 unless procurement forces it.
- Make sure HubSpot tasks/sequence enrollment is suppressed while opp is active (avoid duplicate outreach).
